method: Greedy over a value-first priority list: each batch holds up to five slices whose dependencies are done, partial-but-usable (WS01-S1 lead-only, WS03-S8 S8-A, WS03-S9, WS12-S1) or in an earlier batch, and whose files[] are pairwise disjoint (hot files sse.rs, agent.rs, http_routes.rs, chat-client.ts, DashboardComposer.tsx, mod.rs, mp-contracts lib.rs and every .proto included). Append-only shared docs and compose switch lines (lead_shared_files) are applied by the lead after each batch, so they do not break disjointness.
